'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Paul Bansal DS Combat Readiness''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Paul Bansal]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet deck name '''Chocolate on my Pants'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Combat Readiness|Combat Readiness (V)]]
* '''Username:''' DarkBro
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
